description: EXACT keyword / phrase search over the Ortexo Romanian legal database (codes, laws, Fiscal Code, OMFP accounting norms, and case law). Matches precise wording, ranked by how many of your words a passage holds and searched in full inside the principal codes — use it ONLY when you know the exact term, phrase, defined name (e.g. an account name), article number or figure. For a described concept or a natural-language question use search_semantic instead — lexical returns noise for prose. For court decisions set `sources` to ["jurisprudence"] (with both corpora the results are ranked together and may all be legislation): disputes, deductibility challenges or 'has a court ruled'.

sources.description: Corpora to search. Defaults to ["legislation"]. For Romanian case law (court decisions) use ["jurisprudence"]: with both corpora the results are ranked together and may all be legislation.

name: search_lexical
